title.zh: 将安蒂克省 Sibalom 市镇 Pis-anan 国立中学－Sibalom 附属校从该校分离，改设为名为 Sibalom 国立中学的独立国立中学并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Pis-anan National High School – Sibalom Annex in the Municipality of Sibalom, Province of Antique From the Pis-anan National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Sibalom National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Sibalom của Trường Trung học Pis-anan Quốc gia tại Đô thị Sibalom, Tỉnh Antique khỏi Trường Trung học Pis-anan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Sibalom Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Sibalom ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pis-anan แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Sibalom จังหวัด Antique ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pis-anan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Sibalom แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Sibalom, Sekolah Menengah Pis-anan Nasional di Kotamadya Sibalom, Provinsi Antique dari Sekolah Menengah Pis-anan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Sibalom Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Pis-anan National High School – Sibalom Annex in the Municipality of Sibalom, Province of Antique is hereby separated from the Pis-anan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Sibalom National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Pis-anan National High School – Sibalom Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Sibalom National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Sibalom National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Pis-anan National High School - Sibalom Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
